note: Edited from the Dell svchost.exe TaskCache capture, record 939678. Changed RuleName, Image, TargetObject, Details, User. CutePDF Writer registering its monitor, written by spoolsv.exe as SYSTEM. Upstream filters this out with filter_optional_cutepdf, which tests Image, TargetObject, Details and User at once. The port cannot hold that filter, so it alerts here. The case keeps the cost visible.
